appDescription: Noraehaja is a parked-car karaoke app that searches Korean karaoke videos, plays a numbered search result, and evaluates short microphone recordings.

function.name: SEARCH_SONG
function.description: Searches karaoke videos by song title or artist and displays matching results for the user to select.

query.description: The song title, artist name, or both to search for.

function.name: SELECT_SONG
function.description: Selects and plays a numbered item from the current karaoke search results while parked. The index is the one-based number displayed in the results and returned by SEARCH_SONG.

index.description: One-based number of the song in the current search results.
